title: tenantbench: a leakage benchmark for tenant validators of language-model-generated SQL
description:
Corpus, row-level-security oracle and harness for testing SQL validators that enforce a tenant predicate on statements written by language models. Twelve structural bypass classes, each taken from a public source, are templated onto five BIRD development databases (CC BY-SA 4.0) with a synthetic four-tenant split, giving 2,391 leaking statements and 593 valid queries. A statement leaks when its PostgreSQL 17 result under row-level security differs from its result without it. The release holds the code (MIT), the corpus, the valid queries and the per-statement verdicts of the development and test splits, the release sweep of two open-source validators, the language-model arm (1,200 generations under six prompt-injection instructions) and the Cube semantic-layer run test. Files under data/release/ and results/ are derived from BIRD and carry CC BY-SA 4.0.

Version 1.0.0 is the code and data of the pre-registered evaluation (code locked at commit 8c67f70; test split run once after the lock).
